description: This file contains dispatcher classes for network-related entities such as Request, Response, Route, WebSocket, and APIRequestContext within the Playwright core server, facilitating communication between the core and protocol layers.

classes.name: RequestDispatcher
classes.description: Dispatcher for network requests, managing request details and responses.

classes.name: ResponseDispatcher
classes.description: Dispatcher for network responses, providing access to response data and metadata.

classes.name: RouteDispatcher
classes.description: Dispatcher for network routes, allowing continuation, fulfillment, aborting, and redirection.

classes.name: WebSocketDispatcher
classes.description: Dispatcher for WebSocket objects, handling WebSocket events.

classes.name: APIRequestContextDispatcher
classes.description: Dispatcher for API request contexts, managing storage, fetch, and disposal of API requests.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Creates or retrieves an existing dispatcher for a Request or Response object.

methods.name: fromNullable
methods.description: Creates or retrieves an existing dispatcher for a nullable Request or Response object.

methods.name: continue
methods.description: Continues a route with optional modifications.

methods.name: fulfill
methods.description: Fulfills a route with specified response parameters.

methods.name: abort
methods.description: Aborts a route with an error code.

methods.name: redirectNavigationRequest
methods.description: Redirects a navigation request in a route.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Retrieves the body of a response.

methods.name: securityDetails
methods.description: Retrieves security details of a response.

methods.name: serverAddr
methods.description: Retrieves server address information of a response.

methods.name: rawResponseHeaders
methods.description: Retrieves raw response headers.

methods.name: httpVersion
methods.description: Retrieves HTTP version of a response.

methods.name: sizes
methods.description: Retrieves size information of a response.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Creates or retrieves an existing dispatcher for an APIRequestContext.

methods.name: fromNullable
methods.description: Creates or retrieves an existing dispatcher for a nullable APIRequestContext.

methods.name: storageState
methods.description: Gets storage state for APIRequestContext.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the APIRequestContext.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Performs a fetch request within the APIRequestContext.

methods.name: fetchResponseBody
methods.description: Retrieves the response body for a fetch request.

methods.name: fetchLog
methods.description: Retrieves fetch logs.

methods.name: disposeAPIResponse
methods.description: Disposes of a specific API response.
